Criteria.TestCondition: All functionality can be accessed and executed using only the keyboard.
Criteria.TesterComment: We could not finish this test, so a person needs to check it. The page has an embedded frame we could not read that we cannot check automatically; please check it works with the keyboard. Only the first 40 elements were checked for menus that open when the mouse rests on them. We looked for: things a mouse can click that the keyboard never reaches, including inside frames; menus that open when the mouse rests on them; custom controls that ignore Enter and Space; and tooltips with information found nowhere else. Results are for the browser used (version 153.0.8010.12).

Criteria.TestCondition: Individual keystrokes do not require specific timings for activation of functionality.
Criteria.TesterComment: Nothing on this page asks you to press keys at a certain speed, hold a key down, or press a key several times quickly.

Criteria.TestCondition: There is no keyboard trap.
Criteria.TesterComment: We moved through the whole page with Tab and with Shift+Tab, and keyboard focus never got trapped. The page seems to load more content as you scroll, and the recording could not show all of it; content after the feed was reached only by Shift+Tab from the end. 3 collapsed control(s) (menus, accordions) were not opened; content behind them was not checked for traps.

Criteria.TestCondition: A visible indication of focus is provided when focus is on the interface component.
Criteria.TesterComment: We moved keyboard focus to each of the 54 elements we could reach, and every one showed where focus was.

Criteria.TestCondition: When an interface component receives focus, it does not initiate an unexpected change of context.
Criteria.TesterComment: We moved keyboard focus to each element we could reach, and none of them opened a new page or window or moved focus somewhere else on its own.

Criteria.TestCondition: The focus order preserves the meaning and operability of the web page.
Criteria.TesterComment: We could not finish this test, so a person needs to check it. The focus order departs from the reading order (focus jumps back up the page from "About NASA's Mission" (link) to "Join Us" (link); focus jumps back up the page from "Join Us" (link) to "Home" (link); focus jumps back up the page from "Missions" (link) to "Humans in Space" (link); focus jumps back up the page from "Science" (link) to "Aeronautics" (link); focus jumps back up the page from "NASA en Español (opens in new tab)" (link) to "NASA on Facebook (opens in new tab)" (link)), and we could not tell whether that matters. Please tab through the page and check. After opening "News & Events" (button), the next Tab moves into what it revealed. After opening "Multimedia" (button), the next Tab moves into what it revealed.

We could not tell whether "Year" (drop-down) has a label people can see. Please look at it.
